subject: choice of "full.score" for factor scores estimation  whether TRUE or FALSE

messages.author: 3fd30254cc2deeb1
messages.subject: choice of "full.score" for factor scores estimation  whether TRUE or FALSE
parts:
Dear Chalmers,
while using the fscores () function to obtained the factor scores, I am confused whether to use full.scores = TRUE or full.scores =FALSE options because I don' t have a clear mind about the difference between the factor scores obtained depending on for each unique pattern (full.scores = FALSE) and  the factor scores depending on  for each response pattern (full.scores = TRUE).

Is there any documentation to get detailed information about it because there is a great gap between the factor scores by the way between the standard errors depending on the choice of factor scores.

I wonder about the background of each selection so as to provide justifications about the related selection in the paper.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: choice of "full.score" for factor scores estimation whether TRUE or FALSE
parts:
You nearly always want to use full.scores=TRUE; this computes the score for each row of your input data object (hence, is a score for each unique individual). The other option is more used as a summary/presentation table for each unique response vector, and is generally only useful for very small tests (e.g., 5-8 items). HTH.

Phil
